Current projects are grouped by research program.

# Current Research

## AI, Machine Learning, and Economic Measurement

::: {.research-item}
### Representation Risk in Pretrained Image Encoders
<p class="status-line">Submitted</p>

Studies representation risk: different plausible pretrained image encoders applied to the same images can produce materially different downstream conclusions. The paper compares modern and legacy encoders across economic, medical, biological, and demographic tasks and studies representation selection, combination, robustness, uncertainty, computational cost, and a reproducible software framework.

[Software](software.qmd#lookagain-ml)
:::

## Econometric Methods and Inference

::: {.research-item}
### Which Policy Works, and Where? Estimation and Inference for State-Level Treatment Effects in Difference-in-Differences
<p class="authors">Nichole Austin, Sunny R. Karim, Erin Strumpf, and Matthew D. Webb</p>
<p class="status-line">Submitted</p>

Distinguishes aggregate from state-level and other sub-aggregate treatment effects, and studies inference for policy comparisons across jurisdictions, cohorts, periods, and policy types.

[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01467)
:::

::: {.research-item}
### Improved Inference for CSDID Using the Cluster Jackknife
<p class="authors">Sunny R. Karim, Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, James G. MacKinnon, and Matthew D. Webb</p>
<p class="status-line">Working paper</p>

Develops cluster-jackknife inference for the Callaway-Sant'Anna difference-in-differences estimator and provides companion implementations in Stata and R.

[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12043) · [Software](software.qmd#csdid-jackknife) · [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8xLv7Bu-_l0)
:::

::: {.research-item}
### Good Controls Gone Bad: Difference-in-Differences with Covariates
<p class="authors">Sunny Karim and Matthew D. Webb</p>
<p class="status-line">Working paper</p>

Studies identification with time-varying covariates and introduces the Intersection Difference-in-Differences (DID-INT) estimator.

[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.14447) · [DID-INT software](software.qmd#did-int)
:::

::: {.research-item}
### Jackknife Inference with Two-Way Clustering
<p class="authors">James G. MacKinnon, Morten Ørregaard Nielsen, and Matthew D. Webb</p>
<p class="status-line">Revisions requested at Econometric Reviews</p>

Develops jackknife variance estimators and inference methods for linear models with clustering in two dimensions.

[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.08880) · [Software](software.qmd#twowayjack) · [Watch video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9UorOgryxzc)
:::

::: {.research-item}
### Difference-in-Differences with Unpoolable Data
<p class="authors">Sunny Karim, Nichole Austin, Erin Strumpf, and Matthew D. Webb</p>
<p class="status-line">Submitted</p>

Develops UN-DID methods for estimating treatment effects when data held in separate silos cannot be pooled.

[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.15910) · [UN-DID software](software.qmd#un-did)
:::
